The product-owned menu-button class uses content-driven height while the existing 44px minimum target is retained for multiline native/English copy. The href anchor retains its direct content children. Preserve the href anchor, original select/retry/open-change payloads, locale presentation source, and all existing menu, keyboard, outside-pointer and controlled-open handlers.
